thread:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident P123456 triggered for service `embed-service` (canary) — Canary healthcheck failed 3/5. Alert: `embed-service-canary-healthcheck`.

incident-bot: page fired to #eng-oncall, routing policy=pager->oncall (primary). Escalation: 5m -> senior.

sara: acked. I'm looking. Anyone nearby?

morgan: i'm awake, oncall next. grabbing logs.

sara: quick triage: traffic shows a spike in 502/503 on /v1/embeddings for requests with long text (>8k tokens). Canary ratio at 10%.

natalie: CS reports 3 customers with errors and a Zendesk ticket open. Impact approximate 1–3% of requests, but high for those customers.

sara: kubectl logs from embed-canary-5:
```
2026-03-15T02:13:10Z ERROR TokenizerError: Unknown token id -1 at token_data.py:214
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/tokenizer.py", line 78, in encode
    raise TokenizerError('unknown id')
TokenizerError: Unknown token id -1
```

morgan: looks like tokenizer model mismatch vs runtime — image tag v2.7 uses new tokenizer mapping. Canary pods pulling `embed:v2.7-canary`.

sara: good catch. Trying a quick mitigation: divert canary traffic to fallback model `embed:v2.6-stable` via traffic-split.

ops-bot: `kubectl -n prod set image deployment/embed-service embed-container=registry/redwood/embed:v2.6-stable --record`

lee: i'm switching the traffic split in the router now (nginx-layer). Will move canary -> 0%.

lee: done. Canary pool traffic set to 0% at 02:15:28Z. Monitoring error-rate.

sara: error-rate p95 for /v1/embeddings dropped from 12.9% -> 0.4% within 45s. Customers still seeing some retries but overall improved.

natalie: notifying impacted accounts: emailed AcoTech and ByteCart with update and temporary mitigation.

morgan: we should rollback the canary image and lock the tokenizer mapping. Propose: `deploy rollback --service embed-service --to-tag v2.6-stable --scope canary` then re-run CI/QA for tokenizer mapping.

sara: agreed. Initiating rollback.

ops-bot: Run job `deploy/rollback/embed-service` started at 02:16:40Z. Job ID rb-20260315-31416.

ops-bot: Job rb-20260315-31416: success at 02:17:20Z. Canary image replaced with `v2.6-stable`.

morgan: validating metrics: 5m error rate baseline 0.1-0.3% now. No increase in latency. Logs show tokenizer errors gone.

sara: paging update: incident escalations cancelled. Will keep the thread open for handoff and postmortem notes.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident P123456 automatically acknowledged by sara at 02:14:05Z and resolved by morgan at 02:18:00Z (status: resolved -> non-incident). Recorded runbook step: rollback canary image when tokenizer mismatch.

sara: handing off to lee for postmortem draft and customer follow-up tracking. @lee you're owner for the postmortem? :+1:

lee: taking ownership. I'll draft the postmortem and add timeline + action items (rollback gating, tokenizer validation step in CI). Target: draft by EOD.

natalie: CS to follow up with affected customers and update incident in Zendesk.

sara: thanks all. Incident closing in thread. Action items: (1) add token mapping validation to predeploy checks, (2) harden canary traffic ramp rules, (3) alert threshold tuning for tokenizer errors.

morgan: adding me as reviewer for the PR. I'll include unit test for tokenizer edge-case.

sara: closing notes: root cause = tokenizer mapping mismatch introduced in `embed:v2.7-canary` build. No data exfiltration. Impact limited to request failures. No customer PII affected.

lee: closing incident here at 02:20:50Z. Postmortem link will be posted when ready.

ops-bot: Incident P123456 closed. Thank you.
